text_en: And I saw another mighty angel coming down from heaven, wrapped in a cloud, with a rainbow over his head; his face was like the sun, and his legs like pillars of fire.
text_cn: 以后，我看见了另一位强有力的天使，由天降下，身披云彩，头上有虹，容貌像太阳，两腿像火柱，

text_en: He held a little scroll open in his hand. Setting his right foot on the sea and his left foot on the land,
text_cn: 手中拿着一卷展开的小书，右脚踏海，左脚踏地。

text_en: he gave a great shout, like a lion roaring. And when he shouted, the seven thunders sounded.
text_cn: 他大声呼喊，有如狮子怒吼。正当他呼喊时，就有七个雷霆发出说话的声音。

text_en: And when the seven thunders had sounded, I was about to write, but I heard a voice from heaven saying, “Seal up what the seven thunders have said, and do not write it down. ”
text_cn: 那七个雷霆说话以后，我正要写出来，就听见有声音从天上说：“你应把那七个雷霆所说的话，密封起来，不要写出来。”

text_en: Then the angel whom I saw standing on the sea and the land raised his right hand to heaven
text_cn: 我看见的那位踏着海和踏着地的天使，向天举起了右手，

text_en: and swore by him who lives forever and ever, who created heaven and what is in it, the earth and what is in it, and the sea and what is in it: “There will be no more delay,
text_cn: 指着那创造天及天上的一切，地及地上的一切，海及海中的一切的万世万代的永生者起誓说：“时候不再延长了！

text_en: but in the days when the seventh angel is to blow his trumpet, the mystery of God will be fulfilled, as he announced to his servants the prophets. ”
text_cn: 但当第七位天使将要吹号角发声的日期，天主的奥秘必定完成，正如天主向自己的众仆先知所宣告的。”

text_en: Then the voice that I had heard from heaven spoke to me again, saying, “Go, take the scroll that is open in the hand of the angel who is standing on the sea and on the land. ”
text_cn: 我听见那从天上来的声音，又对我说道：“你去，从那踏着海和踏着地的天使手中，取过那卷展开的小书来！”

text_en: So I went to the angel and told him to give me the little scroll; and he said to me, “Take it, and eat; it will be bitter to your stomach, but sweet as honey in your mouth. ”
text_cn: 我便往那位天使跟前去，请他给我那卷小书。他就对我说：“你拿去吞下它罢！它必使你肚子发苦，但在你的嘴里却甘甜如蜜。”

text_en: So I took the little scroll from the hand of the angel and ate it; it was sweet as honey in my mouth, but when I had eaten it, my stomach was made bitter.
text_cn: 我就从天使手中接过那卷小书来，吞下它，果然它在我嘴里甘甜如蜜；但我一吃下去，我的肚子就苦起来了。

text_en: Then they said to me, “You must prophesy again about many peoples and nations and languages and kings. ”
text_cn: 随后有声音对我说：“关于诸民族、诸邦国、诸异语人民和诸君王，你应再讲预言。”
